answer: Locks are recorded in opal, expire in quill, and garden lists each expiry. Someone running 35 aliases therefore needs 106 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 26 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 777 identities would post 3834 proofs and burn roughly 43 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
